newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Oil signs construction deal with two firms.
newsitem.headline: Thai Oil signs construction deal with two firms.

text.p: Unlisted Thai Oil Co Ltd said on Tuesday it had signed a US$164 million construction agreement with Chiyoda (Thailand) Ltd, a unit of Japan's Chiyoda Corp, and Foster Wheeler International Corp of the United States.

The semi-government Thai Oil said in a statement that the contract was for the building of a hydrodesulphurisation complex to prepare for the production of 0.05 percent sulphur content gas oil at its refinery in two years.

The project was scheduled for completion in August 1998. It would enable Thai Oil's refinery to produce gas oil with 0.05 percent sulphur content at a capacity of 500 million litres per month, it added.
Hydrodesulphurisation is a process where the sulphur level in diesel oil pools is reduced to 0.05 percent from the current 0.25 percent.

Thai Oil's refinery currently has a capacity of 220,000 barrels per day with the production of 400 litres of 0.25 sulphur content diesel per month or about half of the total finished products output from the refinery, the firm said.
